facts.fact: The National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences, with the agriculture ministry, produced a crop map for winter 2023/24 and summer 2024 by governorate (wheat, clover, sugar beet) from remote sensing data and AI, the authority's chairman said on 4 November 2024.

EGY.note: Nothing on AI rules or harms.
AI is used inside a sector (crop mapping), not general administration.

facts.fact: The National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences with the agriculture ministry used AI on remote sensing data to inventory and classify field crops for winter 2023/24 and summer 2024 across governorates, as its chairman said on 4 November 2024.

EGY.note: No AI model release, dataset or computing facility stated.
